metadata.scope: Servo brackets, servo horns, robot arm links, wheel hubs, gripper fingers, chassis plates.

material_suggestions.use_case: functional servo brackets and arm links
material_suggestions.notes: Best printed option; resists flex fatigue better than PETG.
Easy to print; use metal inserts for servo mounting holes.

standards_used.name: MG996R servo body dimensions
standards_used.applies_to: body clearance pocket and mounting holes
standards_used.note: Body 40×20×43.5 mm; tabs span 49 mm apart; M3 mounting holes.

standards_used.name: SG90 micro servo
standards_used.note: Body 22.5×12×29 mm; tab span 28 mm; M2 mounting holes.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: MG996R servo bracket (U-bracket)

fit_guidance_mm.servo_pocket: servo body + 0.5 mm clearance each side

main_features: two side walls with servo body clearance pocket
servo mounting tab holes through side walls
design_rules: servo body pocket is rectangular cutout in side walls
mounting tab holes align with tab_span distance
side walls thick enough for M3 bolt: ≥4 mm
plate extends past tabs for rigidity
validation_criteria: servo body pocket subtracted from side walls
two tab holes subtracted through side walls
failure_modes: pocket too tight — servo does not fit
single flat plate without walls — no pocket

constraint_checks.expression: servo body cutout cube in difference
constraint_checks.message: Servo bracket must have a rectangular servo body pocket.
Servo bracket needs two mounting holes matching tab span.
